comment: Written BEFORE any code reads SEVERITIES. Each case runs the court forged from panel_v35.haro on a sentence of panel/ (with panel/world.json unless world is false). first: a fragment of the first line; contains / lacks: fragments of the whole output; counts: the verdict's counts per verb; diagnose: the first warning of the envelope. P24, the ALSO seat and the explicit error on NEXT and GADGET, and the words of P15 and P16, were added after the code, found by designing the plants; (the cites of P7 were added after the code: the reader in the guard of a diagnose case requires them). twin: the code of a warning the TWIN (v35/panel_errors.haro, the same language without SEVERITIES) must refuse with, in exactly the words the warning carries.

cases.name: a clean sentence: no warning at all
a FORM walks a flow declared elsewhere: ok, and the warning in the seat's own MESSAGES and CODES
contains: warning UNRESOLVED_INTENT_FLOW: FORM search walks the INTENT_FLOW 'checkout', and no flow of that name is declared (line 2)

cases.name: the seat beside it is not held: a missing NEXT is refused as it always was
cases.first: panel (line 2): FORM search hands on to 'checkout', and no flow of that name is declared

cases.name: both: the error refuses, and a refused sentence speaks no warning
cases.first: panel (line 2): FORM search hands on to 'payment'

cases.name: two forms, two warnings, in the order of the sentence
contains: warning UNRESOLVED_INTENT_FLOW: FORM search walks the INTENT_FLOW 'checkout'
warning UNRESOLVED_INTENT_FLOW: FORM pay walks the INTENT_FLOW 'payment'

cases.name: a list seat not held: refused by its first missing element
cases.first: panel (line 2): WORLD_VIEW members lists the INTENT_FLOW 'checkout'

cases.name: the warning in the envelope: severity warning, the seat's code, cited as the code it would have refused with
a view shows an entity the world lacks: ok, and the warning in the SYMBOL's words and code
contains: warning UNRESOLVED_ENTITY: WORLD_VIEW members shows the entity 'ghost', and the world declares no entity:ghost (line 2)

cases.name: without a world the entity is NO_WORLD, as before: not resolved, so not a warning of its own
the entity the world has: clean
WIDGET is read past and said: ok, counted nowhere, the warning in the NAMED words and code
contains: warning UNSPECIFIED_DECLARATION: WIDGET names a rendering, and a declaration that needs to say card has stopped describing intent (line 2)

cases.name: WIDGET and USER, each said, in order; what follows a skipped kind is read
contains: warning UNSPECIFIED_DECLARATION: WIDGET names a rendering
warning UNSPECIFIED_DECLARATION: USER is not a kind this language defines (line 3)

cases.name: GADGET is NAMED and not held: refused, as it always was
a kind read past is not declared: a reference to it dangles
cases.first: panel (line 3): FORM search hands on to 'checkout', and no flow of that name is declared

cases.name: what is read past must still be a declaration: an unclosed body is refused
cases.first: panel (line 2): WIDGET card opens '(' and never closes it

cases.name: and it carries its RATIONALE
cases.first: panel (line 3): RATIONALE is mandatory on every declaration (WIDGET card has none)

cases.name: a sentence of nothing but a kind read past declares nothing
the NAMED warning in the envelope, with the refusal's cites
INTENT_FLOW_NO_SATISFIES: absent and empty each said, the flow with intents not
contains: warning INTENT_FLOW_NO_SATISFIES: INTENT_FLOW browse declares no intents (line 1)
warning INTENT_FLOW_NO_SATISFIES: INTENT_FLOW idle declares no intents (line 2)

cases.name: ROLE_UNDECLARED: said once, on the first interaction
contains: warning ROLE_UNDECLARED: the surface declares interactions and gives none of them a role (line 1)

cases.name: one role is enough
all five in one sentence, and one error-free verdict
a wrong word in a seat is never a warning
a list held at warning: one warning per element that resolves to nothing, in the order written
contains:
warning UNRESOLVED_ALSO: FORM search also serves 'checkout', and no flow of that name is declared (line 2)
warning UNRESOLVED_ALSO: FORM search also serves 'payment'
